40 M+

No.1

Product Story

What’s the big idea?

Curated Style, seamless,
premium shopping experience.

Who is persona?

Meet Arya—a busy engineer and mom.

With a housewarming party ahead, she needs stylish outfits and home decor but no time for endless scrolling.

What is Arya’s goal?

Arya wants seamless experience—from paying bills, fashion to essentials—without the clutter, she expects speed, personalisation, and full control over her experience.

Challenges

Lack of Personalization

A one-size-fits-all homepage overwhelms users with irrelevant sections, reducing engagement and conversion.

Disconnected Experience

The offline and online stores feel disjointed, failing to replicate the premium in-store ambiance for digital users.

Inconsistent Design

Lack of guidelines has led to misaligned banners, fonts, and weak hero images, disrupting brand identity.

Marketplace Feel

Missing brand colors and high-quality visuals make the platform feel generic rather than exclusive.

User Behaviour

65% of users scroll only 5-6 times, meaning important sections placed beyond this go unnoticed.

Hero Banner Visibility

Hero product images lack prominence due to small height and text overlays, reducing impact.

Design Goal

✅

Be the User

🧠

Know the User

📖

Understand the User

  • Learns user preferences to deliver personalised fashion.
  • Also identifies pain points throughout user journey.

🔄

Sync with the User

Beyond a Single Frame

Creating a shopping experience that feels effortless and as a personal style advisor

A Homepage That Knows You

🚧

A static homepage feels generic, failing to adapt to user preferences.
Shoppers expect a personalized experience that reflects their style and needs.

🧠

💡

Think of a store where a stylist instantly picks outfits for you—no endless browsing.
We built 16 smart sections, dynamically showing 8 to 10 tailored ones based on behavior and trends.

📈

✅ Faster discovery → See what matters instantly.
✅ Higher conversions → Less friction, quicker decisions.
✅ A homepage that evolves with you.

Built a dynamic Recommendations system That Evolve With user’s every interaction

🚧

🧠

💡

By syncing wishlists, searches, past orders, and browsing patterns, the platform learns and adapts, delivering curated, relevant styles—just like a personal stylist.

📈

✅ More relevant suggestions → Less browsing, faster decisions.
✅ Higher engagement → Users return for experiences.

Personalized based on browsing patterns.

Smart Reorders: Personalised ⏰ Reminders and boosting recurring revenue 🚀

🚧

Customers forget to repurchase essentials, leading to lost recurring sales and 🔻 reduced retention.

🧠

💡

We built a dynamic “Buy Again” section that 🔄 adapts to order history.
Implemented 💡dynamic nudges like “Refill Now,” based on purchase patterns.

📈

✅ Seamless repurchasing → Fewer steps, faster checkouts.
✅ Increased retention → Customers return for effortless reorders.
✅ Boosted revenue → A frictionless system for recurring sales.

Event-Based Shopping: Personalised & proactive 🎯

🚧

Missed Plans : Last-minute ⏳ rush leads to missed essentials.
Lost 🔍 Items: Previously liked products are hard to find.

🧠

Contextual Triggers: Users 🛒 are more likely to buy when products align with upcoming events.

💡

A dynamic recommendation system that curates event-based collections, surfacing products at the right time.
create urgency without feeling pushy.

📈

✅ Effortless shopping → No need to search, everything’s pre-curated.
✅ A frictionless, intuitive shopping journey → Shopping that adapts to you.

Turning Likes 😍️ into checkouts

🚧

Love the product, but hesitate due to price, availability, or indecision.
Delayed decisions = Lost sales.
Without 🔔 reminders, interest fades.

🧠

Familiarity Bias: Users are more likely to engage.
Loss Aversion: Fear of missing out drives action.

💡

By reminding users of their previously liked styles with smart triggers.
Urgency⚡, not pressure = More conversions.

📈

✅ Reduces hesitation → Timely triggers encourage action.
✅ Enhances engagement → Keeps users connected to their favorite finds.
